status_values.cited: stated in the method paper, docs or code at the given line
status_values.inferred_from_code: follows from the cited code, not stated in words
status_values.约定: 约定，未经推演: not found in the method sources; basis given

canonical_frame: project motion.npz: right-handed Z-up, metres; native Y-up maps (x, y, z) -> (x, -z, y) (utils/motiogen/motion.py:17-18,55-61, applied in utils/motiogen/adapters.py:80-81)
paths: baselines/... are relative to the data root (config/baselines.json data_root); other paths are repository paths

forward_axis.basis: baselines/CLoSD/closd/utils/torch_utils.py:201-212 calc_heading "the heading is the direction on the xy plane ... this is the x axis heading"

units.basis: IsaacGym SI units; goal distances in metres in comments (baselines/CLoSD/closd/env/tasks/humanoid_im.py:749)

fps.basis: baselines/CLoSD/closd/data/cfg/env/im_single_prim.yaml:35 "controlFrequencyInv: 2 # 30 Hz" with SIM_TIMESTEP 1/60; the planner (DiP) runs at 20 fps internally and is converted to 30 fps (closd.py:133-140)

floor.definition: IsaacGym ground plane, normal +Z, distance 0 (the code sets only the normal; PlaneParams().distance defaults to 0.0, read from the installed gymapi 2026-11-09)
